name: ATOMIC CANNON Mk II
tagline: Two of four, and dj-Nate's Robotic Nightmares weaponised.

facts.note: The level's own description reads “Verified by Zeronium. Level 2/4 in the ATOMIC CANNON series”. Zeronium verified it on 1 June 2023 after 17,336 attempts, and it entered the Demonlist at #54 on 26 July 2023. Ranked #193 on the Demonlist as of 30 August 2026. The object count and length are the Geometry Dash fan wiki's; GDBrowser returns 0 for this level, which means unavailable.

spotlight.sub: Lieb's ATOMIC CANNON series, with Giron building alongside and Zeronium verifying.

voice.hook: A series, not a level — and this is the second shot.
voice.why:
ATOMIC CANNON Mk II is the middle of a four-level series by Lieb, and the series is the point: each one is a shot, numbered, with the same name and a bigger number. dj-Nate's Robotic Nightmares runs underneath it.

Giron built alongside Lieb and Zeronium verified it, which the level says in its own description. It sits at #193 on the Demonlist.
